players.product: solder-resist ink and substrate process materials (Taiyo Ink) - Daeduck Electronics / Simmtech supplier

quarterly_data.signal: Taiyo Holdings states it has been notified by KJ005 Co., Ltd. (the tender offeror for its common shares) that the planned tender offer, previously aimed to commence around early October 2026, is now aimed to commence around late November 2026. KJ005 has completed the procedures required under competition laws in Japan, Taiwan, Germany, Tunisia and Vietnam and under investment regulations in the United States, but not yet those under competition laws in China and under investment regulations in Japan, which it aims to complete in November 2026; advance procedures in Spain and Israel proved unnecessary and Korea requires post-closing rather than advance procedures. Taiyo Holdings will announce promptly when notified of the commencement or any change in timing.
quarterly_data.figure: tender offer commencement aimed around late November 2026 (previously around early October 2026)
